name: Lake Ladoga (Kokoirevo)
description: Sandy beach on the shore of the largest lake in Europe. Monitoring shows water conforms to safety standards.

name: Lake Lembolovskoye
description: Popular recreation area near Vasaskari, but swimming is currently prohibited due to bacterial pollution metrics.

name: Lake Mednoye
description: Artificial reservoir with dark peat water. Passed safety inspection tests successfully.

name: Lake Krasnoye
description: Beautiful lake near Korobitsyno ski resort. Environmental warning issued: high iron concentration.

name: Lake Vuoksa (Priozersk beach)
description: Clean municipal beach area. Clear water, safe for family swimming activities.
